verdict.rationale: Card-issuing APIs can reasonably manage PINs and 3DS, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents an API for setting or resetting PINs, or for enrolling cards in 3DS. The only 3DS mention (lithic-docs-24) covers Auth Rules decisioning on the 3DS authentication event stream, which is an adjacent feature, not credential management or enrollment.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets
